title: A simultaneous subterminal site presentation and its module equivalences
statement: Let $\mathcal T=\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal S)$ be a Grothendieck topos presented on a small site $\mathcal S$ [def-weil-pbc-topos], let $R$ be a commutative ring object, and let $U,V\hookrightarrow1$ be subterminal objects with $U\cup V=1$; put $W=U\times V$. There is a full subcategory $\mathcal E\subset\mathcal T$ with a set of objects, closed under finite limits and containing the sheafified representables of $\mathcal S$ and $1,U,V,W$, with a small subcanonical site structure whose covers are the jointly epimorphic families (up to choice of a set of representatives). In particular $\{C\times U,C\times V\}\to C$ is a cover for every $C\in\mathcal E$. The nerve $N(F)(C)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal T}(C,F)$ is an equivalence $\mathcal T\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal E)$ carrying every object of $\mathcal E$ to its represented sheaf. For $Z=1,U,V,W$ it identifies $\mathcal T/Z$ with $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal E/Z)$ for the localized topology [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and carries the restricted ring $R_Z$ to $N(R)|_Z$. These equivalences induce additive exact equivalences of the categories of module sheaves over these rings [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and triangulated equivalences of their ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. They commute with restriction and its composition comparisons; hence their identifications of left and right adjoints preserve the adjunction units, counits, and nested-localization adjunction mates.

proof.text: Use the proved generators helper of ToposCompatibleGenerators: take the union of the original sheafified representables with 1,U,V,U×V and close under terminal objects and pullbacks using ObjectProperty.limitsClosure. Pass to its small model. This gives a single full faithful finite-limit-preserving inclusion F and chosen representatives for the four objects. The helper works directly in Sh(J), for an arbitrary Grothendieck topology J, so no replacement covering site is required.

proof.text: Use the proved arbitrary-topology helpers in SheafSubcategoryComparison with pullbacks preserved by F. Set the precoverage to the epimorphic precoverage; it is a site and subcanonical, its nerve is an equivalence, and representables are represented by full faithfulness. At any original section, the covering sieve in the hypothesis locally supplies a U or V section. Product preservation lifts this section to F(X×U) or F(X×V); the two candidate maps agree there. Separatedness makes them equal on the original section, proving the binary families epimorphic. Apply exists_small_coveringFamilies to the entire epimorphic covering class to choose a small representative class with equal supports. Membership in that class implies a cover, and every cover has a representative with the same support.

proof.text: For every X in E, transport the over category along the nerve and the canonical represented-object isomorphism. Compose with the fibre quasi-inverse of localizedSheavesOverRepresentable. A fibre section corresponds to a map F(T)→B with composite equal to F(T→X); full faithfulness converts the fibre condition into this equality. The inverse sends an over-category morphism to its section under the nerve isomorphism. Their inverse laws and both naturality equations follow from those of the nerve. This proves exactly the displayed sliceFormula.

proof.text: Transport R along the nerve using ringedTopos_equivalenceRingTransport. Its orientation has inverse N.inverse, so invert the ring data with RingData.square, using the identity ring data and N.unitIso. Full faithfulness reflects invertibility of the lifted structural map. Construct its induced module direct image with ringData_inducedModules. The presentationAt helper of RingedPresentationTransport gives the whole module transport. Obtain source slice data from ringed_sheaf_slice_adjunction and element-map continuity from element_site_descent.

proof.text: Apply the separate normalized ringed-nerve slice transport result to these already constructed nerves and the whole module transport. Restrict its family indexed by all objects of E to the four chosen objects. This supplies the actual localized rings, ringed slice inverse images and all normalized module comparisons. The original site and cover constructions have already been proved, so this is only the remaining coefficient/module part of the argument.

proof.text: Convert each RingedPresentationAt to BinaryPresentationModules. Exactness and additivity are its recorded forward/backward properties; the ordinary derived equivalence is the actual mapDerivedCategory equivalence, so both functor equalities are reflexive. For any comparison square between equivalences, the mate is invertible: the left-mate assertion is the proved equivalentMate_isIso helper; for the right mate, the hom map induced by its component is a composite of the equivalence hom bijections, the two adjunction bijections and the comparison hom isomorphism. The mate-counit equation identifies this composite, so Yoneda proves componentwise invertibility. Thus binaryAdjointSquare fills both actual mate fields without additional hypotheses. All normalized equalities are those of the supplied module comparisons.
